decisions.rationale: Test fully set-based execution to minimize gets, alongside moderate bulk and cache variants to map trade-offs between buffer cache reads and PGA usage across all loops.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically cuts logical I/O at higher memory. Test combining SET_BASED upsert (s5) with cached lookups and bulk processing, or testing single-site cache tradeoffs to map the f1 vs f2 frontier.
Test caching only s2 while leaving s3 SET_BASED to discover intermediate trade-offs between low memory (~2.3MB) and low logical I/O (~5.8k gets), exploring asymmetric cache allocations.

LOOKUP_CACHE dominates I/O reduction, while SET_BASED at s5 minimizes memory. Testing combinations where only s2 or s4 uses cache with ROW/BULK options explores the gap between 2.3MB-2.8MB and 15MB+ PGA.
Test isolating single lookup cache (s4 only) to find lower memory trade-offs, and test BULK_5000 combinations to explore lower consistent gets.
Evaluate SET_BASED with BULK_5000 on s4 cache, explore lower-memory cache combinations, and check BULK_5000 on s3 alone to push Pareto boundaries on gets versus PGA.

Test lower PGA boundary combinations: evaluate whether SET_BASED on s1 and s3 without LOOKUP_CACHE can reduce PGA below 2304KB with BULK or ROW on s5, and explore minimal BULK combinations under LOOKUP_CACHE.
Explores hybrid configurations with s2 cached and s4 SQL, combining low logical I/O from s1 batching with lower PGA overhead than double caching.
Test caching on s4 only with BULK options on s3, combined with SET_BASED or low-memory options on s1, to explore trade-offs between low f1 and lower f2.
Test BULK_5000 in s3 with s1 BULK_50/ROW or s3 BULK_5000 with s1 SET_BASED/ROW to find Pareto-optimal f1 below 5812 or explore low memory boundaries.
Test fully set-based execution to minimize consistent gets, plus intermediate bulk variations with lookup caching to explore trade-offs between memory and logical reads.

LOOKUP_CACHE drastically reduces f1 while increasing memory. Combining SET_BASED with LOOKUP_CACHE where applicable, or varying batch sizes for bulk operations, helps map the low-f1 and intermediate memory trade-off space.
Test caching only one lookup site to probe intermediate memory overheads, and test SET_BASED at s1 or s3 combined with LOOKUP_CACHE at the other.
Test SET_BASED for s1/s3 paired with LOOKUP_SQL while varying s5, and explore lower BULK limits with LOOKUP_CACHE to optimize the f1-f2 trade-off between 2.3MB and 15MB.
Test caching only s2 with SET_BASED downstream, and explore low-limit bulk on s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE and ROW/SET_BASED permutations to discover lower-memory cache configurations.
Test BULK_500 on s1 paired with ROW on s3 and cache combinations to bridge the trade-off gap between 24.8k and 5.8k gets while checking lower memory limits.
Test BULK_5000 on s1 with BULK_500 on s3 and s5=SET_BASED, explore LOOKUP_CACHE memory trade-offs with ROW on s1, and evaluate intermediate bulk sizes on s3 to improve Pareto resolution.
Test s2/s4 LOOKUP_CACHE asymmetric splits with SET_BASED and ROW/BULK variants, targeting intermediate trade-offs between f1 and f2.
Test lower memory limits for s1/s3 cache variants and explore unmeasured s5=SET_BASED pure SQL configurations that may beat the current f2 boundary (2304KB).
Exploring the low-memory, low-gets frontier around SET_BASED/SQL configurations: BULK_50 on s1 or s3 with LOOKUP_SQL and SET_BASED s5 offers low PGA while reducing gets compared to ROW.
Test pure SET_BASED across all loops for minimal logical I/O, alongside varying BULK and LOOKUP_CACHE combinations to explore memory and buffer cache trade-offs.
LOOKUP_CACHE achieves massive f1 reduction at high f2 cost. Test caching selectively or pairing BULK loops with LOOKUP_SQL to find balanced trade-offs between 2.3MB and 16.5MB memory.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically reduces f1 while SET_BASED at s5 minimizes memory overhead. Testing BULK_5000 with LOOKUP_CACHE and s5=SET_BASED pushes f1 lower, while exploring caching only s2 isolates memory trade-offs.
Test mix of BULK and ROW or smaller batch sizes with LOOKUP_SQL to probe memory-efficient configurations, and test single cache lookup at s2 to see if memory can be halved.
Test single-cache configurations with ROW loops to explore the trade-off between f2 (minimal PGA overhead) and f1 reduction from caching only one table.
Test combinations of ROW and BULK on s1/s3 without LOOKUP_CACHE to optimize f2 and f1 simultaneously, and test s1=BULK_500 with s3=ROW/LOOKUP_CACHE to improve the low-f1 trade-off.
Test single-lookup cache combinations with BULK/SET to isolate cache overhead, and check smaller bulk sizes combined with cache to find intermediate Pareto points between 5814 and 182295.
Combine LOOKUP_CACHE at s2 and SET_BASED at s3 or test smaller bulk sizes with single caches to probe gaps between low-PGA/high-gets and high-PGA/low-gets regions.
Test BULK_5000 in s1/s3 combinations with LOOKUP_CACHE to challenge minimum f1, and test ROW variants without cache to probe low f2.
Test BULK_5000 on both s1 and s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE to check if f1 improves past 5812, test s1=SET_BASED s3=BULK without LOOKUP_CACHE, and explore intermediate low-memory combinations.
Evaluate SET_BASED across loops to dramatically reduce consistent gets, while testing intermediate BULK and cached lookups to explore PGA trade-offs.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically reduces gets (2%) at high memory cost. Testing BULK with LOOKUP_CACHE only on s2 or s4 isolates memory impact, while testing SET_BASED combined with cache/bulk explores the Pareto trade-off.

LOOKUP_CACHE dominates logical I/O reduction, but consumes ~14MB memory. We test isolated caching on s2 and s4 with moderate bulk sizing and SET_BASED to discover intermediate trade-off points on the Pareto front.
Explore whether caching only s2 while keeping s3 SET_BASED or caching only s4 yields lower PGA intermediate points, and test ROW variants without cache for minimal PGA.
Test low-memory configurations combining SET_BASED at s5 with single caches at s2 or s4 to explore the missing trade-offs between 2MB and 15MB PGA.
Testing LOOKUP_CACHE at s2 combined with SET_BASED or SQL at s3/s5 to map the mid-memory frontier, plus exploring low-memory intermediate BULK options with s5=SET_BASED.
Test caching only s2 while keeping s3/s4/s5 minimal or set-based to isolate s2 memory overhead and map intermediate trade-offs between 1.9MB and 15MB.

Test s1 BULK_500 with s3 SET_BASED or s3 BULK_500 to evaluate fine-grained memory/buffer trade-offs around the Pareto boundary, especially variations combining LOOKUP_SQL with SET_BASED and ROW alternatives.
Evaluating BULK_5000 on s1 and s3 with combinations of caching and SET_BASED to discover minimum f1 gains against high-memory bulk thresholds.
Explores minimal PGA boundaries around SET_BASED and tests selective LOOKUP_CACHE combinations between s1 and s3 to find missing intermediate Pareto trade-offs.
Test fully set-based execution to drastically minimize buffer gets (f1), alongside moderate bulk and cache variants to map the memory vs consistent gets trade-off.
LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically reduces gets (f1) while BULK/SET_BASED controls PGA (f2). Testing BULK_50 with cache and SET_BASED combinations explores low memory and low I/O trade-offs across loops.
Combine BULK_5000 at s1/s3 with caching and SET_BASED at s5 to test lowest f1, plus test selective LOOKUP_CACHE caching at either s2 or s4 to explore intermediate PGA trade-offs.

Test combinations of BULK/CACHE in s1 and SET_BASED/SQL elsewhere to bridge low-PGA and low-gets trade-offs, particularly testing BULK_5000 with s5=SET_BASED and mixed caching with low memory footprints.
Evaluating row/bulk combinations with single cache usage to map the intermediate memory frontier between 2.3MB and 15MB, alongside testing if BULK_5000 in s3 improves f1 over BULK_500.
Test lower limit sizes and hybrid caching configurations to explore memory vs gets trade-offs around s5=SET_BASED.
Test low-memory alternatives with s2/s4 LOOKUP_SQL to bridge the low PGA and low gets gap, and test pure low f1 bulk combinations.
Evaluating ROW on both s1 and s3 alongside SET_BASED s5 with LOOKUP_SQL to target low PGA memory (<1984KB), while also exploring SET_BASED across alternative combinations without cache.
Test alternative low-memory configurations around s1=ROW and SET_BASED combinations with LOOKUP_SQL, and explore BULK_5000 lookup variants.
Test caching only s2 or only s4 with row/bulk variants to uncover intermediate memory-IO trade-offs around 14-15MB PGA, and evaluate bulk sizes for s5 on the low-gets frontier.
